query:
SELECT p.closed_at IS NOT NULL AS "closed!: bool",
                      EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM poll_option o WHERE o.poll_id = p.id AND o.position = ?2) AS "option!: bool",
                      EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM poll_vote v WHERE v.poll_id = p.id AND v.account_id = ?3) AS "voted!: bool"
               FROM poll p WHERE p.id = ?1
